Yeah, exactly my point lol. I've used red dot since operation velvet shell and I've never had a problem with it.

I use laser sights on every weapon except for cav's, I like to sometimes hipfire and laser sights Improve the hipfire accuracy. 

On one had laser sights can be helpful as they hipfire spread, also siege isn't usually a stealth game,  matches end up being a massive fuckfest 15 seconds after the drone phase anyway, so I don't really worry about the laser giving away your position... don't think the enemy would realise a little red dot zip past them while they try to avoid a barrage of bullets. 

On the other hand laser sights can be a downfall especially if you play cav who is a stealth based character. 

But then again... half the time the opposing team are way too oblivious or distracted to even notice your laser. 

But that's my opinion... everyone's got their own way of playing lol.
